Again, I refuse to accept the twisted, psychopathic standard that dismisses a farmer having his ears cut off as "just normal crime."

- medical bills
- property damage 
- lost wages
- enormous quality-of-life cost of lost years
- permanent disability

That means, if fully adopted, FSD could produce savings the size of any one of these:
- ~6% of GDP
- The entire Social Security program
- Medicare AND Medicaid
- Roughly 2× the defense budget

At this scale, FSD (and technologies like it) could be one of the first real steps toward an age of AI "abundance" people talk about.

text:
By popular request, you can now text your dot.

Give it a task to take off your plate or something to keep an eye on, using text, photos, or even voice notes. It will text you proactively with relevant updates.

Safe, secure texting via iMessage or RCS. You’re the only one who can text your dot, and your dot can only text you. Rolling out now as a preview for Pro users in the US.

To set it up, tap on your dot’s profile and select ‘Texting’. Your dot has the same context and plugins, wherever you reach it. This doesn’t give your dot or OpenAI access to your other text conversations.

AI is most useful when it works with tools you already use and shows up in places you already are, which is why we're excited to bring dots to texting. 

Please try it and share your feedback so we can make the experience even better for everyone.

Just released the ability to text your dot — even over iMessage — which means you can also do things like send a voice memo when you’re on the go, take a photo and text it, share your location if you’re on iPhone, or just send off a request without opening ChatGPT.

Feels oddly different when texting your dot to manage things — I think it has to do with interfacing where you’re talking to other people.
